_about: PARKED. Endings that are not a launch, the knock-back vector, six trade beats and the lights-against-a-heavy pair (../alchemist-content.md sections 3 and 4). Not loaded, not hashed, no schema. Beat lists use the live tick form, relative to their own start: an ending starts on the string's last contact tick, a trade beat on its own beat. `slot` names the pool a strike is filled from at M0. Which one plays when is Game Design's, after Orb's questionnaire 14.

tempo._live: step, follow, foot, stepIn, heavyWindup are the live profiles.dynamic.tempo names

knockBack.label: KNOCK BACK
knockBack.what: a flat, short send: the body slides on the ground or drifts in the air and stops on its feet. Not a launch: no planner candidates, no bounce, no journey

direction.ground: along the ground, away from the striker; the piece must send across
direction.air: the piece's first direction: across is level, up is 20 degrees above level, down is 20 degrees below

distanceBh._note: PROPOSAL for Game Design, inside its 'under about 8 bh'. A double slide gives each fighter half

kinds.slideShort: under 4 bh: he stays upright on both feet
kinds.slideLong: 4 bh and over: he drops to the low brace, one hand on the ground; World cuts a trench by tier
kinds.bump: an obstacle inside the slide's length stops it: a wall, a formation, a crater's edge; a light brunt inside the collateral budgets
kinds.drift: in the air: he is carried back and rights himself

knockBack.after: the sent fighter is free when the slide or drift ends; the striker is free `advantage` ticks before that
knockBack.stick: the tilt cannot turn a ground slide; in the air it picks among the piece's directions
limits: never a launch's wear: it is a knock, counted apart from launches by QA
it does not start a chain window by itself

endings.after: a string that ended on a light
endings._look: The last light is a push: a palm heel or a shoulder check that sets the rival back a step, and both settle at fighting distance.

endings.after: a string that ended on a light
endings._look: Both hop back a step at the same moment and land facing, still in reach.

endings.after: a string that ended on a light
endings._look: Both give a half step and drift a quarter step round each other, eyes locked: the brawl is still on.

endings.after: a string that ended on a heavy, with no launch earned; on the ground; under 4 bh
endings._look: The loser is driven straight back on both feet, leaning into it; the winner holds the end of the blow.
The loser slides a long way, drops low and brakes with a hand on the ground, cutting a furrow.

endings.after: the same, with an obstacle inside the slide's length
endings._look: The slide ends early against a wall, a formation or a crater's edge: a bump, not a smash.

endings.after: a string that ended on a heavy, with no launch earned; in the air
endings._look: The loser is carried back a few body heights, arms out, and rights himself; nobody falls.

endings.after: a cross-counter on a string's last beat (PROPOSAL for Game Design)
endings._look: Both blows land and both fighters slide apart, each braking the same way.

tradeBeats._look: One lands, and the other lands back half a beat later.
Both blows land on the same tick and both heads snap.
tradeBeats.needs: both in reach; two strikes may land on one tick

tradeBeats._look: The blow is stopped on a forearm or a shin, and the checker answers at once.
tradeBeats.needs: the checked blow is an arm or a leg strike: an arm strike is checked on the forearm, a leg strike on the shin

tradeBeats._look: The two limbs meet between them and both recoil.
tradeBeats.needs: both blows from the same limb family (two hands, or two feet); each limb is solved onto the other

tradeBeats._look: One sways off the line; the other hits air and leans too far.
A short tie-up, collar and elbow, then one shoves the other off.
tradeBeats.needs: both in reach; uses the tie-up of wave 5 and the hold of wave 4

lightsAgainstAHeavy.rule: Game Design (agency-pass.md section 2): three clean lights before the heavy lands stop it
lightsAgainstAHeavy._look: The third clean light lands on the wind-up, and the heavy collapses into a stagger.

lightsAgainstAHeavy.rule: the same rule's other side: fewer than three clean lights, and the heavy comes through
lightsAgainstAHeavy._look: The lights land on a fighter who keeps winding up, and the heavy lands through them.

ops.knockBack: send a fighter by the knock-back vector
ops.stagger: the live stagger of a perfect block (24 ticks)

strikeArgs.slot: link, heavy or ender: the pool the composer fills it from
strikeArgs.o.trade: cross: both strikes of the tick land
strikeArgs.o.checked: the blow is stopped on a limb: no damage, the defender plays a check
strikeArgs.o.clash: limb onto limb: no damage to either
strikeArgs.o.whiff: the blow misses a fighter who slipped it
strikeArgs.o.react: the strength of the computed reaction, 0 to 1.6
strikeArgs.o.push: a shove: no launch, the rival set back to fighting distance
